news.title: Man shot near Washington Park after argument escalated to gunfire, APD says
news.summary: The victim was initially detained, but officers later realized that he was suffering from a gunshot wound. EMS took the man to a local hospital.

news.title: Serious crash hurts 3 in South Fulton, motorcyclist airlifted
news.summary: South Fulton police say officers responded at around 6 p.m. to a serious crash at Camp Creek Parkway and Enon Road.

news.title: Driver seriously injured in single-vehicle crash on I-75 in Cobb County
news.summary: A driver was hospitalized with serious injuries early Saturday in a single-vehicle crash on I-75 in Cobb County, according to police.

news.title: Missing Newton County girl believed to be heading to Texas, deputies say
news.summary: Newton County sheriff's deputies are searching for Royciya Parker, a missing girl last seen in Covington who authorities believe may be traveling to Texas.

news.title: 24-year-old man shot overnight in Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A 24-year-old man was injured after he was shot early Saturday morning in Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Man hospitalized after shooting on Buford Highway, police say
news.summary: A man is recovering in the hospital following an early morning shooting on Buford Highway, according to police.

news.title: Man injured in northwest Atlanta shooting overnight, police recover shell casings
news.summary: A 24-year-old man is recovering after a shooting in northwest Atlanta early Saturday, according to Atlanta Police. An investigation is underway.

news.title: Pair admits role in gang-related hit that left man dead in Gwinnett
news.summary: Two men from out-of-state have pleaded guilty to their roles in a gang-related shooting in Gwinnett County that left one man dead and another seriously injured, prosecutors said.

news.title: Five arrested after fight at East Coweta football game; firearm found
news.summary: A halftime fight at the East Coweta/Newnan football game led to five arrests, says the Coweta County School System, as deputies recovered an unshot firearm.

news.title: East Point police credit new crime center for fast response times
news.summary: The East Point Police Department is using a high-tech Real Time Crime Center to cut response times and monitor criminal activity across the city.
